findings.description: The wooden logs beneath the hull slide along the ground rather than rotating as true roller mechanisms.
findings.fix: Animate cylindrical rolling motion on contact logs or show repositioning crews cycling them forward.
findings.refined_description: The wooden logs tied by ropes to the ship's hull slide directly across the ground without rotating or rolling as the ship moves forward.

findings.description: Background soldiers marching alongside the ships exhibit synchronized gait cycles and identical silhouettes.
findings.fix: Vary animation cycle offsets and soldier scale/posture along the column.

summary: This clip establishes the overland transport of ships at night with clear lighting and atmospheric smoke. Minor physics issues occur with static log rollers sliding under the hull rather than revolving. Distant crowd extras display slight gait repetition along the hill.
